sentences.en: You know those stories that just live in your brain rent-free?
sentences.zh: 你知道有些故事总是在你的脑海里挥之不去吗？

sentences.en: Like family legends, historical facts, the kind of thing everybody swears is true
sentences.zh: 比如家族传奇、历史事实，那种每个人都发誓是真的事情

sentences.en: because we've heard it all a million times.
sentences.zh: 因为我们已经听过无数遍了。

sentences.en: And then one day, someone starts asking questions.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，有人开始提出疑问。

sentences.en: And suddenly the story gets a little wobbly.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这个故事就变得有点站不住脚了。

sentences.en: That's the idea behind the new podcast, Family Lore.
sentences.zh: 这就是新播客《家族传说》的灵感来源。

sentences.en: It's a podcast that takes those big inherited narratives and pulls them apart.
sentences.zh: 这是一个剖析那些代代相传的宏大叙事的播客。

sentences.en: Not to dismantle them just for the sake of it, but to better understand the whole making of story.
sentences.zh: 不是为了解构而解构，而是为了更好地理解故事是如何形成的。

sentences.en: Coming up, we've got a preview of the Family Lore episode titled,
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们将为大家带来《家族传说》一期节目的预告

sentences.en: If Mosquito Hawks Can Fly.
sentences.zh: 题为《如果大蚊子能飞》。

sentences.en: It follows one family's story claiming that their grandfather took flight before the Wright brothers.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了一个家族的故事，他们声称自己的祖父在莱特兄弟之前就飞上天空了。

sentences.en: Take a listen.
sentences.zh: 请听。

sentences.en: You might remember back in 1999, the United States Mint started producing specialty quarters.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得在1999年，美国铸币局开始生产特种25美分硬币。

sentences.en: On the back of each quarter, instead of an eagle spreading its wings and looking off to the side,
sentences.zh: 在每个硬币的背面，不再是一只展翅翱翔并目视远方的老鹰

sentences.en: you'd see a unique design representing any given state.
sentences.zh: 而是能看到代表各个州的独特设计。

sentences.en: For example, on the back of the Massachusetts quarter, you'd have a minute man.
sentences.zh: 例如，在马萨诸塞州硬币的背面，你会看到一个民兵。

sentences.en: The Virginia quarter featured ships arriving at Jamestown in 1607.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州的硬币上则是1607年抵达詹姆斯敦的船只。

sentences.en: And on the back of the North Carolina quarter,
sentences.zh: 而在北卡罗来纳州硬币的背面

sentences.en: you had a man lying prostrate on a primitive airplane with another man watching from below.
sentences.zh: 有一个人俯卧在一架简陋的飞机上，另一个人在下方观看。

sentences.en: This, of course, was a depiction of the Wright brothers and their inaugural flight
sentences.zh: 这当然是对莱特兄弟及其在小海滩城镇基蒂霍克

sentences.en: at the small beach town of Kitty Hawk.
sentences.zh: 进行的首飞的描绘。

sentences.en: At the top of the coin is the inscription,
sentences.zh: 硬币顶部是铭文

sentences.en: First Flight.
sentences.zh: “首次飞行”。

sentences.en: This is a story that virtually all Americans know.
sentences.zh: 这是一个几乎所有美国人都知道的故事。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers were the first to fly.
sentences.zh: 莱特兄弟是第一个飞上蓝天的人。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers invented the airplane.
sentences.zh: 莱特兄弟发明了飞机。

sentences.en: Or at the very least, the Wright brothers were pioneers in the field of aviation.
sentences.zh: 或者至少，莱特兄弟是航空领域的先驱。

sentences.en: But there's another story you probably haven't heard
sentences.zh: 但你可能还没听过另一个故事

sentences.en: that makes the origins of American aviation a little more complex.
sentences.zh: 它让美国航空的起源变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: I'm Lloyd Lockridge.
sentences.zh: 我是劳埃德·洛克里奇。

sentences.en: And this is Family Lore.
sentences.zh: 这里是《家族传说》。

sentences.en: This story begins in Louisiana, a state not known for aviation.
sentences.zh: 这个故事始于路易斯安那州，一个并不以航空闻名的州。

sentences.en: Quite the opposite, really.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，其实。

sentences.en: With its bayous, swamps, labyrinthine coastline, and the nation's biggest river,
sentences.zh: 凭借其河口、沼泽、错综复杂的海岸线和全国最大的河流

sentences.en: the state is known for its boats.
sentences.zh: 这个州以船只闻名。

sentences.en: Cajun P-rogues, flat-bottom airboats, paddle steamers, the Higgins boat.
sentences.zh: 卡津独木舟、平底风力船、明轮船、希金斯船。

sentences.en: But the Louisiana man at the center of this episode's family lore was not interested in boats.
sentences.zh: 但本期节目家族传说核心的那位路易斯安那人对船并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He was not interested in navigating the water.
sentences.zh: 他对在水面上航行不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Before the advent of airplanes, this man dreamed of navigating the sky.
sentences.zh: 在飞机问世之前，这个人就梦想着在天空中航行。

sentences.en: His name was Charles Frederick Page.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇。
zh_words: 查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇

sentences.en: And to hear his story, we have traveled to Alexandria, Louisiana in person
sentences.zh: 为了倾听他的故事，我们亲自来到了路易斯安那州亚历山大市

sentences.en: to speak with one of his descendants, Charles Frederick Page's grandson.
sentences.zh: 采访他的后代之一，查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇的孙子。
zh_words: 查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇

sentences.en: So let's just get started.
sentences.zh: 那么我们这就开始吧。

sentences.en: Could you tell me your name, please?
sentences.zh: 能请教一下您的尊姓大名吗？

sentences.en: Joseph P.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·P

sentences.en: Page.
sentences.zh: ·佩奇。

sentences.en: Joseph Page is 87 years old.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·佩奇今年87岁。

sentences.en: He's a veteran of the United States Air Force, and his military background shows.
sentences.zh: 他是美国空军退伍军人，军旅背景历历在目。

sentences.en: His house is tidier than a nuclear submarine.
sentences.zh: 他的房子比核潜艇还要整洁。

sentences.en: And Mr. Page stands with a certain posture,
sentences.zh: 而且佩奇先生站姿挺拔，气度不凡

sentences.en: one that conveys not only physical strength, but a kind of strength of character.
sentences.zh: 传达出的不仅是体力，还有一种人格的力量。

sentences.en: He's the kind of person who, without saying a word,
sentences.zh: 他就是那种无需一言一语，

sentences.en: makes you want to take your hat off when you walk inside.
sentences.zh: 就能让你在走进去时想脱帽致敬的人。

sentences.en: We were greeted by him and his wife of 65 years.
sentences.zh: 我和他以及他结婚65年的妻子受到了热情的接待。

sentences.en: We sat down in his living room and immediately launched into a conversation about his early life.
sentences.zh: 我们在他的客厅坐下，随即聊起了他早年的生活。

sentences.en: Well, I grew up on Highway 20 at East in Pineville.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是在派恩维尔东部的20号高速公路旁长大的。

sentences.en: So we lived in a country and about 100 yards away...
sentences.zh: 所以我们住在乡村，大约100码外……

sentences.en: Joseph came of age in 1950s Louisiana,
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫在20世纪50年代的路易斯安那州长大，

sentences.en: an overtly and unapologetically racist environment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个公开且毫不掩饰的种族主义环境。

sentences.en: Despite living in Pineville,
sentences.zh: 尽管住在派恩维尔，

sentences.en: he had to commute across the Red River to Alexandria
sentences.zh: 他却不得不穿过红河去往亚历山大市，

sentences.en: in order to attend the only all-black school in the area.
sentences.zh: 以便去上当地唯一的一所全黑人学校。

sentences.en: And to add insult to injury,
sentences.zh: 更雪上加霜的是，

sentences.en: even if he were the first person at the municipal bus stop,
sentences.zh: 即便他是市公交车站的第一个人，

sentences.en: he'd have to wait for all the white passengers to board first,
sentences.zh: 他也必须等所有白人乘客先上车，

sentences.en: only to pass them all on his way to the back of the bus.
sentences.zh: 然后还得在走向车后座的路上从他们所有人身旁走过。

sentences.en: Indignities like that were a part of daily life.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的屈辱是日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: And this kind of blatant discrimination was a confusing experience for young Joseph Page,
sentences.zh: 这种赤裸裸的歧视对年幼的约瑟夫·佩奇来说是一段令人困惑的经历，

sentences.en: because his neighbors out in the country were white,
sentences.zh: 因为他在乡下的邻居是白人，

sentences.en: and he'd play with his neighbors all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且他一直都和邻居们一起玩。

sentences.en: But if they saw each other in the town of Alexandria,
sentences.zh: 但如果他们在亚历山大镇上碰面，

sentences.en: they'd have to pretend like they didn't know each other.
sentences.zh: 他们就得装作不认识对方。

sentences.en: I didn't quite understand it as a child.
sentences.zh: 我小时候并不是很理解这一点。

sentences.en: In my mind, I knew it was not right as to why we could be friends
sentences.zh: 在我心里，我知道为什么我们在没有人的时候可以在乡下成为朋友

sentences.en: and hang out together in the country when nobody was around,
sentences.zh: 并一起玩耍是不对的——不对，是觉得为什么这样不对

sentences.en: but we could not associate with each other when we were in Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 但当我们在亚历山大时却不能互相交往，这说不通。

sentences.en: And as a child, you remember thinking,
sentences.zh: 作为一个孩子，你记得自己当时在想，

sentences.en: this doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Yeah, I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实这么想过。

sentences.en: Something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 有些地方不对劲。

sentences.en: I couldn't exactly put my hands on it.
sentences.zh: 我说不上具体是哪里不对。

sentences.en: But by the time I got to junior high school,
sentences.zh: 但等到我上初中时，

sentences.en: I knew for a fact it was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我确切地知道这是不对的。

sentences.en: And I recognized it as discrimination.
sentences.zh: 并且我将其认作是歧视。

sentences.en: Joseph was grappling with these issues in the midst of a national reckoning.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫正值国家进行深刻反省之际艰难面对这些问题。

sentences.en: The Civil Rights Act of 1964 was on the horizon,
sentences.zh: 1964年《民权法案》即将来临，

sentences.en: and the movement for racial equality was gaining momentum.
sentences.zh: 争取种族平等的运动正在积蓄力量。

sentences.en: But Joseph had no illusions about the reality of his situation.
sentences.zh: 但约瑟夫对自己的现实处境没有抱任何幻想。

sentences.en: Despite the promises of civil rights,
sentences.zh: 尽管民权运动作出了承诺，

sentences.en: Joseph's parents told him that he'd need to work twice as hard as white people
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫的父母还是告诉他，他需要比白人付出双倍的努力

sentences.en: to achieve the same results.
sentences.zh: 才能取得同样的成果。

sentences.en: And this was not some abstract lesson.
sentences.zh: 这可不是什么抽象的教训。

sentences.en: It was inextricably connected to the story of the family's patriarch,
sentences.zh: 它与这个家族的大家长、

sentences.en: Joseph's grandfather, Charles Frederick Page.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫的祖父查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇的故事密不可分。
zh_words: 查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇

sentences.en: Charles Page was born in 1864 in Rapides Parish, Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·佩奇于1864年出生在路易斯安那州拉皮德斯帕里什。

sentences.en: He was born into slavery,
sentences.zh: 他出生于奴隶制时期，

sentences.en: which means that Joseph Page's grandfather,
sentences.zh: 这意味着约瑟夫·佩奇的祖父，

sentences.en: not his great-great-grandfather or some distant relative,
sentences.zh: 不是他的曾祖父、高祖父或什么远亲，

sentences.en: but his grandfather was, at one point, enslaved.
sentences.zh: 而是他的祖父，曾经沦为奴隶。

sentences.en: I should have told my grandchildren now
sentences.zh: 我本该现在就告诉我的孙子孙女们

sentences.en: to underscore the point of slavery
sentences.zh: 为了强调奴隶制的残酷

sentences.en: it was not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 其实并没有过去太久。

sentences.en: Think about that.
sentences.zh: 仔细想想。

sentences.en: So tell me one of the first things you remember learning
sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我，你最早记得的

sentences.en: about your grandfather, Charles Frederick Page.
sentences.zh: 关于你祖父查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇的事情是什么？
zh_words: 查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇

sentences.en: Well, my parents and my aunts and uncles
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的父母、阿姨和叔叔们

sentences.en: always talked about it.
sentences.zh: 总是谈论这件事。

sentences.en: When I was a small kid,
sentences.zh: 当我还是个小孩子的时候，

sentences.en: he was a bigger-than-life figure in my mind as a kid.
sentences.zh: 在我心目中，他是一个无比高大的人物。

sentences.en: They always told us about
sentences.zh: 他们总是告诉我们

sentences.en: inventing in the first airship.
sentences.zh: 关于发明第一艘飞艇的事。

sentences.en: In case you didn't catch that,
sentences.zh: 如果你刚才没听清，

sentences.en: Joseph said that he was always told
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫说他从小被告知

sentences.en: that his grandfather invented the first airship.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父发明了第一艘飞艇。

sentences.en: And we would go, as school kids would do,
sentences.zh: 就像学校里的孩子一样，我们会去

sentences.en: we would go to school to the elementary school
sentences.zh: 上小学

sentences.en: and say,
sentences.zh: 然后说，

sentences.en: my grandfather built the first airship.
sentences.zh: 我祖父建造了第一艘飞艇。

sentences.en: And the other kids would laugh at us
sentences.zh: 别的孩子会嘲笑我们

sentences.en: and say, you know, that's not right.
sentences.zh: 说，你知道的，那不对。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers built the first airplane.
sentences.zh: 莱特兄弟制造了第一架飞机。

sentences.en: So as a kid,
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个孩子，

sentences.en: you don't want to be embarrassed by your friends, right?
sentences.zh: 你不想在朋友面前出丑，对吧？

sentences.en: So you stop talking about her.
sentences.zh: 所以你就不再谈论它了。

sentences.en: This claim that Charles Frederick Page
sentences.zh: 关于查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇
zh_words: 查尔斯·弗雷德里克·佩奇

sentences.en: invented an airship
sentences.zh: 在莱特兄弟发明飞机之前

sentences.en: prior to the Wright brothers inventing the airplane,
sentences.zh: 发明了飞艇的这种说法，

sentences.en: this was a strong piece of Page family lore.
sentences.zh: 这是佩奇家族流传甚广的传说。

sentences.en: It's something the family believes to be true.
sentences.zh: 这是家族坚信不疑的事情。

sentences.en: But a lot of people outside the family
sentences.zh: 但家族以外的许多人

sentences.en: are skeptical at beSt.
sentences.zh: 充其量也只是持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Those who knew Charles Page respected him,
sentences.zh: 认识查尔斯·佩奇的人都很尊敬他，

sentences.en: but for other reasons.
sentences.zh: 但出于其他原因。

sentences.en: He was a Renaissance man.
sentences.zh: 他是一个博学多才的人。

sentences.en: He was a timberman,
sentences.zh: 他是一名伐木工，

sentences.en: a cobbler,
sentences.zh: 一名鞋匠，

sentences.en: a botanical farmer.
sentences.zh: 一名植物农民。

sentences.en: He established a cemetery
sentences.zh: 他为派恩维尔的

sentences.en: for the black community in Pineville,
sentences.zh: 黑人社区建立了一个墓地，

sentences.en: the first of its kind,
sentences.zh: 这是同类中的第一个，

sentences.en: the Lincoln Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 林肯墓地。

sentences.en: He had a vision for diversified farming,
sentences.zh: 他对多元化农业有着长远的眼光，

sentences.en: where a tenant farmer
sentences.zh: 在那个愿景下，佃农

sentences.en: could slowly gain equity
sentences.zh: 可以慢慢获得他所耕种土地的

sentences.en: in the land he was working.
sentences.zh: 产权。

sentences.en: But what a lot of his peers didn't know
sentences.zh: 但他的许多同龄人不知道的是，

sentences.en: is that he also had a mind for engineering.
sentences.zh: 他同样有着工程学的天赋。

sentences.en: He would have been a great engineer.
sentences.zh: 他本可以成为一名伟大的工程师。

sentences.en: What my grandmother used to complain about
sentences.zh: 我祖母以前抱怨的事情是，

sentences.en: when she would tell my grandfather
sentences.zh: 当她讲起我祖父的故事时

sentences.en: she needed a new chicken coop.
sentences.zh: 她需要一个新的鸡舍。

sentences.en: He needed to build her a new chicken coop.
sentences.zh: 他需要为她建一个新的鸡舍。

sentences.en: He would get out the ruler
sentences.zh: 他会拿出尺子

sentences.en: and a pencil and paper
sentences.zh: 还有铅笔和纸

sentences.en: and he would design it
sentences.zh: 然后他会设计它

sentences.en: and he would do all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 他会做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: All I need is a simple chicken coop.
sentences.zh: 我只需要一个简单的鸡舍。

sentences.en: It did not have to be like perfect, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它不需要那么完美。

sentences.en: But Charles Page had bigger ambitions
sentences.zh: 但查尔斯·佩奇有着更大的野心

sentences.en: than state-of-the-art chicken coops.
sentences.zh: 远超最先进的鸡舍。

sentences.en: And one evening,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，

sentences.en: while sitting on his porch,
sentences.zh: 正当他坐在门廊上时，

sentences.en: he got an idea from an unlikely contributor,
sentences.zh: 他从一个意想不到的灵感提供者那里得到了启发，

sentences.en: the mosquito hawk.
sentences.zh: 那就是大蚊子（蚊母鹰）。

sentences.en: Those big, gangly,
sentences.zh: 那些体型巨大、细长、

sentences.en: slow-moving, mosquito-looking insects
sentences.zh: 行动迟缓、长得像蚊子的昆虫

sentences.en: that you tend to see in the spring and fall.
sentences.zh: 你通常在春秋两季会看到它们。

sentences.en: The story I heard repeatedly
sentences.zh: 我反复听到的故事是

sentences.en: was that he would sit on his porch in the evenings
sentences.zh: 他傍晚会坐在门廊上

sentences.en: and watch the flight of those mosquito hawks.
sentences.zh: 看着那些大蚊子的飞行。

sentences.en: And that inspired him to figure out
sentences.zh: 这激发了他去琢磨

sentences.en: how he could duplicate that
sentences.zh: 他该如何复制这种飞行

sentences.en: and fly himself
sentences.zh: 让自己也能飞起来

sentences.en: and figure out how to do that.
sentences.zh: 并研究出如何做到这一点。

sentences.en: And in the ensuing weeks, months, or even years,
sentences.zh: 在随后的几周、几个月甚至几年里，

sentences.en: nobody knows for sure,
sentences.zh: 具体多久没人说得准，

sentences.en: Charles Page worked on a way to fly.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·佩奇一直在研究飞行的方法。

sentences.en: And he had a deadline.
sentences.zh: 而且他有一个最后期限。

sentences.en: He needed to design and build something
sentences.zh: 他需要设计并制造出一样东西

sentences.en: in time for the 1904
sentences.zh: 好赶上1904年的

sentences.en: Louisiana Purchase Exposition,
sentences.zh: 路易斯安那购地博览会，

sentences.en: which was held in St. Louis, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 该博览会在密苏里州圣路易斯举行。

sentences.en: To hear the full episode
sentences.zh: 若想收听完整节目
